HP Recovery + Sustain · Equipment is shared for units by CLASS in presets automatically, too, with you being allowed multiple presets a class. So you don't need to grind for things individually for a character. The game's focus is the many, many, many modest that offer passives and incremental stat increases for your entire roster. And actually getting to that point is not very difficult at all!

Mage · Magical DPS

Only job is to kill things · Ranger · Physical DPS

Only job is to kill things · Retribution · Balance · Life · Attributes follow the color wheel:
R → G → B

Cycle & Ruin Clash! · Each advantageous attribute is 30% more DMG. You get a 10% bonus for every unit in your party that shares the same attribute. The game is balanced assuming you have the full 60% buff at all times. There's also Magic/Physical restrictions in later modes, meaning that you will need a variety of units. The meta can shift because of this. As such, one would say that you should build every unit. They're free anyways! As daunting as this sounds, the game offers many, many events & functions that to quickly build said units.

sections.body: After you beat World 1 Stage 7-9, you unlock your first SR Ticket! Get Deia & upgrade her Chaser to Rank 20 (CL20)! This is to unlock Deia (T) through Job Change! Use Deia in all parties & drop 30 ultimates! Use Urara & Grandiel from Support Party to help with SP! [You want to unlock Mayden (T) with this method as well]

sections.title: During this Phase, you should unlock most content. You can breeze the game easily so the f
sections.body: During this Phase, you should unlock most content. You can breeze the game easily so the focus will be to minimise wasting resources and building duplicate units. The TL;DR is to just build units one at a time to CL25 FSI while completing Assembly. The game will throw resources at you while you do content on the side. Try not to spread resources or go for dupes before acquiring every unit you can get! Get them all first!

sections.title: Continuing from above, you will start by trying to unlock Deia (T). Use Deia in every batt
sections.body: Continuing from above, you will start by trying to unlock Deia (T). Use Deia in every battle until your job change missions are done! Do note that there is no way to use ULTIMATES automatically, so doing these missions means you need to use a HERO's ULTIMATE 30 times. Every time. The rest is somewhat automatic as you play. · Once you get her, build her! Soul Imprint 15 (FSI) is the minimun requirement to consider characters "usable". Use material gained from rewards like World Boss & Missions. Do not use DUPES for anything! Do not aim for them, either! · You should aim to build ONE unit at a time, starting with their Chaser, then continuing off to finish their Soul Imprint. A unit is fully built when they are CL25 & FSI
